requirements.Additional_Comments: Printer to meet intervention spec for the different media and climatic conditions for Manhattan platform.
requirements.Goal: Pass intervention rate and NO PQ issue
requirements.Remarks: 20220920(Sau Pin): LP2 Life test are meeting Intervention rate(Qual) 20220316 (Sau Pin): I assume baseline is same as Manhattan. Status as "Yellow" as need to review interventon performance. Accept threshold. EM media as Eval media.
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications and minimum print quality (PQ) by region and climatic conditions, as defined for the Manhattan platform.

Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. Only Malbec Hi had issue with input tray flag broken.
